records.source: Samsung Q60R (2019) product generation timeline
records.notes: Samsung Q60R QLED sets are the 2019 model-year generation and remained in the following sales cycle. The R generation letter is model-year specific (N=2018, R=2019, T=2020), so this record must never be widened to a bare "Q60" pattern, which spans unrelated generations. A production range is model-era evidence and does not establish the manufacture date of an individual unit.
